title: Beyond Prompt Count: How Data Shapes Transfer in On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2609.37377v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains students using teacher feedback on their own sampled responses, yet how prompt choice shapes transfer across teacher-student pairs remains poorly understood. We systematically study prompt quantity, source, and selection across RL- and SFT-continuation pairs and cross-model settings. We find that OPD can be highly prompt-efficient: a few prompts can approach large-pool performance, with four DAPO prompts matching the observed mathematics score of 3,840 DeepMath prompts. However, prompt utility is relational rather than intrinsic: changing only the teacher can reverse the relative effectiveness of mathematics and code prompts. To characterize these transfer differences, we analyze parameter and functional changes across prompt supports and model pairs. translated_title: 超越提示数量：数据如何塑造在线策略蒸馏中的迁移
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）利用教师模型对学生自身采样回复的反馈来训练学生模型，然而提示的选择如何影响不同师生组合之间的迁移，目前仍知之甚少。我们系统性地研究了在RL-与SFT-继续训练对以及跨模型设置下，提示的数量、来源与选择方式。我们发现OPD可以具有极高的提示效率：仅需少量提示即可逼近大型提示池的性能，例如四个DAPO提示所取得的数学成绩可与3,840个DeepMath提示相当。然而，提示的效用是关系性的而非内在的：仅更换教师模型就可能逆转数学与代码提示的相对有效性。为了刻画这些迁移差异，我们分析了不同提示支持与模型组合下的参数变化和功能变化。与教师模型的功能对齐程度因提示支持和目标任务而异；在继续训练对中，与教师对齐的预测变化可以与……
tldr: 该论文系统研究了在线策略蒸馏中提示选择的作用，发现OPD具有极高的提示效率（少量提示即可媲美数千个提示的大池），但提示效用是关系性的而非内在的——仅更换教师模型就可能逆转不同领域提示的相对有效性。
en_tdlr: The paper systematically studies prompt choice in on-policy distillation, finding that OPD is highly prompt-efficient (a few prompts can match performance of a large prompt pool), yet prompt utility is relational rather than intrinsic—merely changing the teacher can reverse the relative effectiveness of domain-specific prompts.
